jobs.title: SDE III
jobs.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Software Development Engineer III (SDE III) with strong expertise in Node.js, React, and modern web application architecture. The ideal candidate will play a key role in designing, developing, and scaling high-performance applications while providing technical leadership to engineering teams. This role requires hands-on coding, system design expertise, mentoring capabilities, and a strong focus on delivering scalable, secure, and maintainable software solutions.

Key Responsibilities
Technical Leadership
Lead the design and development of scalable, high-availability web applications.
Drive architectural decisions and establish engineering best practices.
Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and technical discussions across teams.
Mentor junior and mid-level engineers and support their technical growth.
Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, QA, and DevOps teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
Backend Development (Node.js)
Design and develop RESTful APIs and microservices using Node.js.
Build secure, scalable, and performant backend systems.
Optimize database queries and application performance.
Implement authentication, authorization, and security best practices.
Work with event-driven architectures, queues, and distributed systems.
Frontend Development (React)
Develop responsive and intuitive user interfaces using React.js.
Build reusable component libraries and frontend frameworks.
Implement state management using Redux, Context API, or similar solutions.
Optimize frontend performance and improve user experience.
Ensure cross-browser compatibility and accessibility standards.
System Design & Scalability
Design distributed systems capable of handling high traffic and large datasets.
Participate in architecture planning and technical roadmap discussions.
Implement monitoring, logging, and observability solutions.
Ensure reliability, fault tolerance, and performance optimization.
Quality & DevOps
Write clean, maintainable, and testable code.
Implement automated testing (Unit, Integration, E2E).
Support CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
Participate in production support and incident resolution.
Required Qualifications
Experience
6–10 years of professional software development experience.
3+ years of hands-on experience with Node.js in production environments.
3+ years of experience building modern frontend applications using React.js.
Experience leading projects or mentoring engineering teams.
Technical Skills
Backend
Strong proficiency in Node.js and TypeScript/JavaScript.
Experience with Express.js, NestJS, or similar frameworks.
Deep understanding of REST APIs and microservices architecture.
Experience with message brokers such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or SQS.
Knowledge of authentication protocols (OAuth, JWT, SSO).
Frontend
Strong expertise in React.js and modern React patterns.
Experience with Redux, Zustand, Context API, or equivalent state management.
Expertise in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript ES6+, and responsive design.
Familiarity with component-driven development.
Databases
Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL).
Experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis).
Database design and performance tuning.
Cloud & DevOps
Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes.
Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation.
Engineering Practices
Strong understanding of software design patterns and principles.
Experience with system design, scalability, and performance optimization.
Proficiency in Git and collaborative development workflows.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with GraphQL.
Experience building SaaS or enterprise-scale products.
Familiarity with serverless architectures.
Exposure to event-driven systems and distributed architectures.
Knowledge of observability tools such as Datadog, New Relic, Prometheus, or Grafana.
Soft Skills
Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to drive technical discussions and influence architecture decisions.
Ownership mindset with a focus on quality and execution.
Success Metrics
Delivery of scalable and reliable software solutions.
Reduction in system performance bottlenecks and production issues.
Improved engineering quality through code reviews and mentoring.
Successful execution of complex projects with minimal supervision.

Location: [Remote/Hybrid/Onsite]
Experience: 6–10 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Department: Engineering / Product Development
